examples.text: I had an extremely frustrating experience with Aspora and I strongly advise others to think twice before using this app. First and foremost, there is no option to cancel a transaction once it has been initiated - for any reason whatsoever. Even though I contacted them before the debit happened, they were unable to assist. Their support is practically useless when something actually goes wrong. I chose Aspora just to save 40 paise compared to other providers, and I deeply regret that decision. When everything goes smoothly, any provider seems fine. But a company’s true reliability shows when there is a problem and this is where aspora completely failed. I’ve learned my lesson: it’s better to go with a trusted and well-established provider like Remitly rather than trying to save a few cents and ending up with such a stressful experience. I have never written a review for any app before. This is my first time doing so - only because I don’t want someone else to go through the same stressful and frustrating experience that I did. Extremely disappointing service overall.

examples.text: If you are traveling & sending money to where you are staying to someone be ready to have to call every single time you wire money. Calls are recorded & they retain all provided information so unless new verification is required on something not formerly requested no further verification should be needed when making a transaction. With Remitly this is not the case you will have to call each time & verify the same exact information for each transaction before they release funds according to their policy. Until this is fixed I don’t recommend anyone use Remitly.
examples.title: Not Good for Abroad Transfers

examples.text: I’ve been a legitimate customer using Remitly for 2 years to send money to people I’ve personally met while traveling internationally. Out of nowhere, my account was suspended pending additional review. I fully cooperated and provided every piece of information they requested. What was most disappointing wasn’t the review itself, it was how I was treated. During my support chat, I asked multiple times to speak with a manager because I wanted to understand what was happening with my account. The representative told me they were scheduling a call and specifically stated that someone would call me. Instead, the chat was immediately closed without any manager, explanation, or opportunity to continue the conversation. Being told you’ll receive a call only to have the conversation abruptly ended leaves you feeling ignored rather than helped. Compliance reviews are understandable. Every financial institution has an obligation to follow AML and KYC regulations. What isn’t acceptable is making promises to customers that aren’t honored and leaving them without clear communication. I hope someone from Remitly’s management team reviews this experience because this isn’t the level of customer service I expected from a company handling people’s finances. I would appreciate someone from Remitly Leadership or Executive Customer Relations reaching out to review my case and the way it was handled.
examples.title: Extremely disappointed with Remitly’s customer service.
